activation_condition: Complete residual_scaled's frozen 500 updates and native checks first. Only activate if the remaining joint failure includes noisy signed negative temperature while the raw-residual protection and main weak denoising pass.
question: Does increasing exposure to existing negative noisy training cases reduce the remaining signed temperature failure at the same 500-update budget?
control: residual_scaled, restarted from the exact same v4/update2000 CNN weights and an empty Adam state

sampler.slot_0: Keep the original first noisy draw unchanged.
sampler.slot_1: Replace the original second noisy draw with an existing TRAIN negative noisy case. Alternate negative_weak and negative_normal, each with a seeded shuffled round-robin over its 12 existing cases.
sampler.slots_2_3: Keep the original continuous and quantized training draws unchanged.

budget.device: Windows local RTX4060 Laptop; no server GPU

interpretation_limit: This is a development-motivated sampling intervention. It repeats a small existing signed training set and does not establish real-camera generalization or prove that sampling is the sole cause. All new checkpoints remain local, and every failed checkpoint is retained.
